decisions.text: type bar: categories compared by value
clustered bars: 3 series of one measure across categories (G1.56, R9-12)
nominal categories sorted by value, descending (by series cash)
3 series side by side in each cluster, the bars touching, in the same order in every cluster: Cash (slot 1), Credit card (slot 2), Cheque (slot 3) (G7.5, G4.22)
every name fits under its bar, neighbours at least 10 pt apart: vertical bars
the unit phrase on the top label: “$6,000 (monthly donation)”; the top gridline starts after it
exact values needed: a table under the graph, one column under each cluster, the series as rows (Cash, Credit card, Cheque), no rules, the numbers bare, the unit the scale's (G1.14, G7.46, D-52)

the table's rows keyed by their series' colours (each name where it stands without keys, then its key square on the value axis, where the gridlines begin), in the order of the bars in each cluster; the squares 9.0 pt after the names and 8.9 pt before the first column of values (G5.8, G5.14; owner, 1 Oct 2026)
a legend above the plot, below the title, centred over the plot: labels beside the bars of a cluster would each need a leader (G5.7, G5.10, D-7)
legend entries in the order of the bars in each cluster, left to right: Cash, Credit card, Cheque (G5.8, G5.14: square keys)

source.shows: the legend kept above the plot as well (table.legend keep), as the book draws it
